entities.summary: Daniel Lopatin, best known as Oneohtrix Point Never or OPN, is an American electronic music producer, composer, singer, and songwriter. He began his career in the early 2000s as part of Brooklyn's noise music scene and later received early acclaim for the synthesizer-based compilation Rifts (2009) as well as the influential vaporwave side-project Chuck Person's Eccojams Vol. 1 (2010). His work since has experimented with tropes from an eclectic range of musical genres and eras, and has featured sample-based composition and complex MIDI production.
